home.storyTitle: A tea brand built on fresh fruit

about.title: About TIANLALA
about.lede: A global fruit tea brand, brewing fresh since 2015.
story: TIANLALA began in 2015 with one idea: fruit tea should taste like fruit. Not syrup, not concentrate — fruit cut fresh in store, every day.

That standard turned a single shop into a global brand of more than 8,000 stores. In 2023 the group opened a Singapore operations centre to serve markets beyond China, bringing together supply chain, R&D, training and brand teams under one roof.
Riyadh is the newest chapter. Same fruit, same standard, brewed for the Kingdom.

values.title: Fresh, never concentrate
values.body: Fruit is cut in store. If it is not good enough to eat, it does not go in a cup.

values.title: Priced to be a habit
values.body: A drink you can afford more than once a week, without cutting the quality.
